description: This file defines the class Image_Graph_Marker_Average, a marker used in the Image_Graph library to display the distance to the dataset's average value, including methods for drawing the marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Average
classes.description: A marker class that displays the distance to the dataset's average value in the Image_Graph library.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker on the canvas, highlighting the average position and connecting the marker to it with lines.
